title: Meta VR Start Developer Competition 2026
summary: Build a hands-first entertainment, gaming or productivity experience for Meta Quest or VR Glasses.
eligibility: Legal adults aged 18+. Submitter must join Meta VR Start; listed country exclusions apply.

prize.description: US$1 million cash pool across 20 awards; individual awards vary.

notes: Membership and developer access are required before submission.
A playable build and a video under three minutes are required.
